info.title: Plumsail HelpDesk MS Flow connector v4
info.description: The API allows interact with Plumsail HelpDesk ticketing system. Visit https://plumsail.com/docs/help-desk-o365/v1.x/API/ms-flow.html for more information.

post.description: Creates new ticket and returns created ticket.

parameters.name: $select
parameters.description: An ODATA $select query option to specify which fields to return for a list item. You can use * to return all available fields.

parameters.name: $expand
parameters.description: An ODATA $expand query option to specify that the request returns the values of lookups.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: An ODATA $filter query option to restrict the entries returned

parameters.name: $orderBy
parameters.description: An ODATA $orderBy query option for specifying the order of entries.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: An ODATA $top query option to select the first n items of the return set for return (default = 50, maximum = 100).

parameters.name: $skiptoken
parameters.description: An ODATA $skiptoken query option to skip over items until the specified item is reached and return the rest.
